The '''bombardment of Bosph''' was an attack on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bosph/Legends|Bosph]] in the [[Bosph system/Legends|Bosph system]] of the [[Bosph sector/Legends|Bosph sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The bombardment took place during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] whilst [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harsh]] was in control of the sector. The attack was ordered by galactic [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] after he discovered that the faction based government of Bosph was made up of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals known as ''[[ela b'Yentarr]]''. The bombardment devastated Bosph's grassy surface and [[Death/Legends|killed]] large numbers of Bosphs including the majority of ''eba b'Yentarr''. Due to the vicious attack the remaining Bosphs, who were mostly force to stay on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] due to Imperial quarantine, took up a policy of dis-remembrance toward the Empire, the greatest insult the Bosphs could give. This meant they no longer acknowledged the existence of the Empire and ignored its laws, instead blaming the damage of the bombardment on the [[Deity/Legends|deity]]-like entity known as ''[[Yentarr]]''.
